name: Genesis Technology, Inc.
summary: Genesis Technology, Inc., along with its affiliated entities, delivers a full spectrum of information system integration services and IT solutions throughout Taiwan. Their core activities involve the distribution, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of various software applications, computer hardware, and telecommunications infrastructure. The company's extensive solution set includes advanced software-defined data centers, cutting-edge corporate data storage systems, and strategies for optimizing enterprise core operations. They also specialize in securing corporate digital assets and designing safe, efficient digital work environments. Furthermore, Genesis Technology provides robust information security measures, encompassing foundational infrastructure defense, advanced malware protection, specialized factory security, secure remote access, and comprehensive cloud service security. The firm also develops intelligent communication and digital collaboration platforms. A notable offering is GeCloud, their proprietary hybrid cloud service. Complementing these, the company offers expert IT consulting and professional services. Genesis Technology, Inc. was established in 1983 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
